thread.title: Trust Co Decreases Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Trust Co Decreases Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Trust Co reduced its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.0% during the 1st quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 73,036 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,516 shares during the period. Apple makes up about 5.6% of Trust Co’s holdings, making the stock its 2nd largest position. Trust Co’s holdings in Apple were worth $12,254,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
Other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently modified their holdings of the company. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter worth about $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC purchased a new position in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at about $134,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC purchased a new position in Apple in the 1st quarter valued at about $138,000. Macroview Investment Management LLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 220.3% in the 1st quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $151,000 after purchasing an additional 619 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Litman Gregory Asset Management LLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 553.8% in the 1st quarter. Litman Gregory Asset Management LLC now owns 1,033 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $173,000 after purchasing an additional 875 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors own 58.54% of the company’s stock.
